mission.posting: A request has come in to obtain some information about a target that the client believes is being stored on an eOS device.

email.subject: Jailbreak
email.body:
This will be kept curt. A client has requested that we search the computer and devices of a given target for what they are calling a "Registration ID" - they believe it will be stored on an eOS device sync'd to the target's home computer (link attached).
Once you have this ID, respond here with it, and we'll handle the rest.
Good luck, -CSEC

attachments.note: Scan for EOS devices on target computer Investigate devices for reference to a "Registration ID" Reply to CSEC with said ID attached
